proofStatus.userFacingWording: Marketplace pre-release 1.3.10 is a community-validation preview. The Linux/Docker preview lane is maintainer-validated. Windows/LabVIEW installed-user combinations are selectable so users with those machines can report evidence, but they remain proof-deferred until reproduced or retained by the maintainer proof lane.
proofStatus.shortIssueTemplateWording: Selectable does not mean maintainer-proven. Please include vihs --validate output and the exact provider, LabVIEW year, and bitness so the proof status can be updated from reported to reproduced or deferred.

steps: install the pre-release from the VS Code Extensions view or with code --install-extension svelderrainruiz.vi-history-suite@prerelease
run VI History: Prepare Local Runtime Settings CLI if vihs is not available
run code --version and retain the complete output
run code --list-extensions --show-versions and retain the svelderrainruiz.vi-history-suite line
run vihs and record whether the generated runtime-settings CLI opens
run vihs --validate and retain the complete output
select the exact provider, LabVIEW year, and bitness being validated
open a trusted Git repository containing a tracked .vi, .ctl, or .vit file with at least two revisions
run VI History, select exactly two revisions, review the compare preflight, and choose Compare
file a report with the exact outcome, whether it worked or failed

labels.name: marketplace-preview
labels.description: Report specific to the VS Code Marketplace pre-release channel.

labels.name: windows-labview
labels.description: Windows host or Docker Desktop Windows-container LabVIEW report.

labels.name: proof:reported
labels.description: User evidence received but not maintainer-reproduced.

labels.name: proof:reproduced
labels.description: Maintainer reproduced or retained the reported path.

labels.name: proof:deferred
labels.description: Evidence is insufficient or blocked while the feature remains selectable.

labels.name: needs-reproduction
labels.description: Maintainer reproduction is required before proof status changes.

triageLoop.exitCriteria: version, install route, provider, LabVIEW year, bitness, and outcome are identified
required command output and reproduction facts are present or explicitly requested
report is classified as success, failure, missing version, unsupported path, or documentation mismatch
admitted Windows/LabVIEW host proof is retained or the proof remains explicitly deferred
issue is answered, linked to retained proof, or promoted to a GitLab authority change

requiredBeforeMutation: public GitHub community-validation intake promotion plan
separate explicit publish the public intake now approval
post-publication verification of issue templates and labels
